scope: every numeric and status claim on opengrad-site at commit 3aac71d, recomputed against OpenGrad at 1a1d7de

findings.claim: 100% of Base's unattempted items at 768 were truncations
findings.actual: 99.6% (4,292 of 4,309). The repo reports were corrected for finding 39; the site kept the old figure. The append-only gpu_runs.jsonl seq 7 also says 100%.

findings.claim: Base gets two items wrong; M1-v2 refuses them
findings.actual: Different items: Base gets trap-arithmetic and multi-step-change wrong; M1-v2 refuses multi-step-change and format-constraint and passes trap-arithmetic (sentinel_scores.json). Same error as finding 32, fixed in the repo but not on the site.
$11.39 is the $8.90 continuation plus the $2.49 prior run; the 13 GPU runs are the continuation only. Same population mix as finding 60.

findings.claim: Every number on this page recomputes from 48,840 per-example records
findings.actual: 48,840 covers the capability suite only, not the tool-policy F1 or the corpus audit.

findings.claim: IFEval shown with no token-cap caveat
findings.actual: 47/67/63/17 of 541 IFEval responses (Base/M0/M1-v2/M1-v1) hit the 2,560-token cap. Same caveat as finding 30, added to the repo but not the site.
The class is cannot_answer / UNSUPPORTED, which is what the section text calls it.
